theorems.name: Submission.rpn_pfd_wedge_cons_comp_succAbove
theorems.statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (L : Eucl P →L[ℝ] Eucl (m + 1)) (ℓ : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (j : Fin (m + 1)), wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (Fin.cons (ℓ.comp L) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj (j.succAbove i) : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L) : Fin (m + 1) → (Eucl P →L[ℝ] ℝ)) = ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (j : ℕ) * ℓ (EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ))) • wedgeCovectors (m + 1) (fun i => (EuclideanSpace.proj i : Eucl (m + 1) →L[ℝ] ℝ).comp L)
